CC BY 3.0: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/
Adapted for Bu Ratna: torso garment bound to the formal female skeleton,
khaki fabric colors, skirt and name badge. Attribution is retained here and
in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.txt, which accompanies the Windows distribution.

Quaternius — Bunny (rig, mesh and animation)
https://poly.pizza/m/irZjWFARyl
CC0 1.0: https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/
pengawas.glb is a KALA adaptation of bunny.glb: re-proportioned legs/torso/ears,
rebuilt inverse bind matrices and retargeted translation keys. Runtime colors,
large eyes, broad muzzle, black nose and red scarf match the user's Reka
reference. The original rabbit's small nose/mouth, eyes and carrot are omitted.

Additional uniform collars, badges and mascot facial accessories authored for KALA.
Original downloads and source URLs are recorded in SOURCES.json.
